'''Smoke powder''' was a substance used by the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] [[Umwak]] to fill an area with sight-obscuring powder and allow him to operate unseen. Umwak used smoke powder to keep the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket W. Warrick]] from seeing him steal a potion from the Ewok shaman [[Logray/Legends|Logray's]] hut in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] when the Dulok was impersonating a [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] trader.<ref name="Blue Harvest">{{Ewoks|Blue Harvest}}</ref>
